title: File:Blythe Solar Project (52358029534).jpg
desc:
The Blythe Solar Power Project, a four-unit, 485-megawatt photovoltaic facility and 387-megawatt battery energy storage system in Riverside County, is now fully operational. The project will produce enough energy to power approximately 145,500 homes.
Photo by the BLM.
